M3_no_primitive_substitution._note: A BIND primitive is not substituted into an EXISTS filter (the defect, mechanism 3).

M4_having_error_fails_query._note: HAVING without the guard: an erroring condition fails the whole query instead of dropping the group.

M12_join_sees_bind_primitive._note: The join lookup no longer hides BIND primitives: a group on the right of a join sees the value bound on the left (§18.5 says it must not).

M13_number_as_untyped_string._note: A BIND number is substituted as an untyped string literal: does B2 distinguish the node's form?

M17_lateral_scope_join._note: LATERAL substitutes the outer solution with the "join" scope: a BIND primitive is hidden from the LATERAL subquery, which is correlated by the standard (§18.6).
